ruleset.name: PrintScript PMD ruleset
ruleset.description:
errorprone + bestpractices, with a few rules excluded because they conflict with this codebase's actual design rather than flagging a real defect:
- SwitchStmtsShouldHaveDefault: this codebase relies on switch over sealed interfaces (StatementSyntax, ExpressionSyntax, RuntimeValue) being exhaustively checked by the compiler. Adding a default case would silently swallow a future unhandled case instead of failing the build. - SystemPrintln: the cli module's entire job is writing to stdout/stderr. - AvoidFieldNameMatchingMethodName: fields that share a name with their own accessor method (the record-style convention used throughout this codebase) are not accidental shadowing. - TestClassWithoutTestCases: misfires on testkit's TestSources, a test-fixture helper that lives in a main source set, not an actual test class. - JUnit5TestShouldBePackagePrivate: this codebase signs every field/method/constructor as either public or private, never package-private. Package-private test methods are also not just a style choice here: this project's Gradle/JUnit Platform setup silently discovers zero tests in a class where every lifecycle method (@Test, @BeforeEach, etc.) is private, with no build failure to flag it — verified empirically. Public is therefore the only visibility that is both policy-compliant and safe for test methods in this repo.
